lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in a sparse, semi-regular grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank. These clusters form vertical columns of 3 to 4 nodes each, roughly centered between the dorsal and ventral midlines.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal carinae to form anchor points for the high-luminance blobs, creating a localized grid-like matrix posterior to the gill region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct linear ridges run horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance transition from light on the superior edge to shadow on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains a low-density distribution of approximately 6-8 distinct high-luminance blobs, primarily clustered toward the posterior and basal regions of the fin surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple white, thin, linear features (potential parasites or remora attachments) are visible trailing from the posterior edge and ventral surface of the primary pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense field of micro-spots visible on the cranial region anterior to the gills, and a specific high-intensity spot cluster on the leading edge of the pectoral fin.
